chief_editor_model.role: final prose critic; may not change quant facts

market_critic_model.role: market structure consistency critic using provided facts only

news_sentiment_model.role: summarize only provided source facts; no fabricated news

macro_context_model.role: macro contradiction checker using runtime facts only

hard_limits: LLM must not create or change stance, conviction, actionability, invalidation, or numerical risk metrics.
LLM output must pass delivery safety guard before use.
If OpenRouter key is missing, deterministic renderer remains authoritative.
